text: The chilled mix is drawn into a freezing chamber at the point of sale with the chosen amount of air, churned, frozen quickly and dispensed at once, so it is never hardened.

steps.note: The mix is held unfrozen in the machine.

steps.name: aerate
steps.note: Air is worked in, so the mix grows 0–60 % in volume, 33–45 % being ideal.

steps.name: freeze
steps.note: The mix is frozen quickly and dispensed at once, so it never hardens.
